responsibility: Declares the internal data structures and helper interfaces used by GCC’s tree-level switch-conversion and switch-lowering code. It defines the cluster hierarchy for representing individual case ranges, grouped jump-table and bit-test clusters, and decision-tree nodes used while analyzing a GIMPLE_SWITCH, carrying case labels, basic blocks, and profile probabilities; it also declares the switch_decision_tree and switch_conversion support objects that gather case ranges, choose transformations, build static constructor arrays for value-table conversion, emit replacement GIMPLE/CFG, and release the temporary cluster graph consumed by tree-switch-conversion.cc.
same_name_distinction: Header for the switch-conversion module: it defines the cluster, decision-tree, and switch_conversion data structures and declares helper interfaces shared within the implementation. Unlike tree-switch-conversion.cc, it does not run passes or rewrite GIMPLE/CFG itself.
